senses.gloss: m. (לקק, cmp. לָגִין a. Greek λεκάνη) bottle, flask.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Judges 6:38">Targ. Jud. VI, 38</cite> <he>לקנא</he> ed. Lag. (Var. <cite ref="L00695"><he>לקי׳</he></cite>, <cite ref="L00134"><he>לגינא</he></cite>, Ar. <cite ref="L00670"><he>לקונא</he></cite>; h. text <cite ref="O01381"><he>ספל</he></cite>).—

<cite ref="Berakhot 62a:9">Ber. 62ᵃ</cite> <he>מקרקשא … בלקנא</he> (Ms. O. <he>בלקונה</he>) clappered … with a nut in a flask.
